environment.description: ECS Fargate task deployed in a VPC isolated subnet (rtb-0x4f8a2e) with route table containing only local VPC CIDR (10.200.0.0/16) entries and no 0.0.0.0/0 route. No NAT Gateway, no Internet Gateway attachment, no VPC endpoints for S3/SSM/SecretsManager. Security group sg-0a8b3c permits ingress on 8080 from internal ALB only and egress restricted to 10.200.0.0/16 on port 443 (for service mesh sidecar communication). DNS resolution is handled by Route53 Resolver inbound endpoint forwarding only internal zones (.corp.internal). The task execution role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/NoExternalNetworkBoundary) that explicitly denies ec2:CreateNetworkInterface and ec2:AttachNetworkInterface actions. VPC Flow Logs confirm zero packets to non-RFC1918 destinations over 90-day baseline.

config.dns_resolution: internal zones only via Route53 Resolver
